title: Backup scope · search
expect: Family is the initial search; the summary still describes all three selected albums.
Album rows lead with 44-point rounded cover thumbnails on iPhone and Mac; a missing cover is a neutral tile.
Scroll the virtualized list and toggle a row: cover identity stays stable, off-screen requests cancel, and search, summary and checkmarks remain.

actions.action: Clear search, select another album, browse it, then return.
actions.result: Search, selection and list position survive browsing.
